author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! I once again bring you what the world looks like when the Internet is connected through very large centralized systems. When something goes down the cascading effect is massive and it seems for over a day, one of the biggest Internet services in the world remains offline for many. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: So Microsoft Went Offline...
